clock-hour.title: inè, twazè, senkè
clock-hour.bodyMarkdown:
Learn common clock-time expressions as whole phrases:

- **inè** — one o'clock
- **twazè** — three o'clock
- **senkè** — five o'clock

**inè** can mean one hour or one o'clock depending on the context.

half-past.title: edmi
half-past.bodyMarkdown:
Use **edmi** for half past:

- **twazè edmi** — 3:30
- **setè edmi** — 7:30

Learn each as one spoken time expression.

ask-time.title: Akilè…?
ask-time.bodyMarkdown:
**Akilè…?** asks what time an activity happens.

For example:

**Akilè nou pati?** — What time do we leave?

A short answer can simply be a time expression such as **senkè**.
